toegepas.blok: Die son wys die rigtings buite
toegepas.voor: Dan kyk jy in die ooste en wes lê agter jou rug
toegepas.na: Dan kyk jy na die ooste, en wes lê agter jou rug
toegepas.rede_vinder: One looks 'na' a direction in Afrikaans ('in die ooste kyk' suggests looking at something located there), and the two full clauses need an AWS comma before 'en'.
toegepas.fout: 'kyk in die ooste' is an unusual preposition for facing a direction (it can read as searching in the east), and the comma is missing between two full clauses.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Original and proposal both mean the learner faces east; 'na' only makes that clearer. One word swapped for one, comma required by the AWS, protected sentence after it untouched.

laat_vaar.blok: Die son wys die rigtings buite
laat_vaar.voor: om buite rigtings te vind sonder enige kaart
laat_vaar.na: om buite sonder 'n kaart rigtings te vind
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'sonder enige kaart' after the verb copies English 'without any map'; Afrikaans places the 'sonder' phrase before the object and uses ''n'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Lateral move: putting the 'sonder' phrase after the verb is natural Afrikaans, and 'enige' carries the deliberate emphasis of no map at all, which the proposal weakens.
